# Task #49 deterministic Human Monk level 20 capstone fixture.
# Extends the accepted deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk chassis
# (tests/fixtures/.../pf1_human_monk_level12_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 20 as chosen input only. It names selections; it contains no
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture of every earlier Monk fixture,
# changing only the class level.
#
# Level 20 is the first level at which the whole Monk capstone band is
# reachable, so this single fixture exercises every feature the cap
# widening admits at once: Diamond Soul (13), Quivering Palm (15),
# Timeless Body (17), Tongue of the Sun and Moon (17), Empty Body (19)
# and Perfect Self (20), plus Abundant Step (12, a pre-existing gap
# rather than one the widening admits).
#
# It also pins the three formulas whose upper bands only exist above the
# old level-12 ceiling: the unarmed strike die at its final 2d10 band,
# the Flurry of Blows fourth attack (15th level onward), and Slow Fall's
# genuinely unlimited "any distance" case, which the feature's own rule
# text states outright rather than continuing the 10-ft progression.
#
# It deliberately avoids every Monk burden surface that remains unbuilt:
# no execution of what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no
# ki-power execution, no ki-strike damage-reduction-bypass resolution,
# no fall-damage engine, no teleportation-resolution engine for Abundant
# Step, no save-or-die resolution for Quivering Palm, and no
# creature-type engine for Perfect Self's Outsider clause.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level20
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:20
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:deflect_arrows
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
